title: qPanDa: FAB Production Data Processing and Reporting Solution
description: Designed and built a distributed, fault-tolerant, and scalable FAB production data processing solution capable of ingesting any tabular data structure. This tool is capable of processing and reporting on petabytes of data on a daily basis. It works with any format, making it extremely flexible for a variety of use cases.
longDescription: Created a highly scalable and fault-tolerant data processing pipeline that handles large volumes of data from Qualcomm's Product and Test Engineering fabrication data. The solution was recognized as a Top 5 Innovation across Qualcomm globally in a 2021 business review, and resulted in processing speed improvements of over 400% compared to the previous system.
